verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Pilot publishes an llms.txt at pilot.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at a first-party LLM-oriented file. The visible content is only a short entity and category summary, and the probes found no markdown doc variants (faq.md returned 404) and no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt carries substantive service or doc content, markdown/agent-oriented doc pages, machine-readable API spec, independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://pilot.com/llms.txt # Pilot
